The sun is lower, the light is softer, and your guests won't be melting. If a midday ceremony is unavoidable, choose a shaded location — under trees, a pergola, or a covered structure.

Avoid scheduling outdoor ceremonies between 11 AM and 3 PM when the sun is harshest.
